title: Inventor Content Lifecycle and Normalization Governance

scope.purpose: Govern how project, legacy, or external Inventor parts, assemblies, and drawings are assessed, normalized, approved, promoted for reuse, changed, superseded, and retired.
scope.boundary: The source page contains explicit gaps in outputs, authority detail, normalization criteria, and change steps. This object preserves only source-supported durable rules and records the missing areas rather than filling them by inference.

requirements.statement: Inventor content proposed for reusable governed status shall be identified and assessed before promotion from project-specific or legacy use into a standard library.
Candidate reusable Inventor content shall be checked against applicable identity, naming, structure, manufacturing-documentation, and project-commitment constraints before normalization.
Normalization shall establish governed identity, structure, style, lifecycle state, ownership metadata, and traceability sufficient for reuse and change management.
Promotion into a governed standard library shall require approval by the applicable manufacturing or discipline authority and any required BIM governance authority.
Superseded or retired reusable content shall be clearly distinguishable from current reusable content to prevent accidental reuse.

open_gaps: Source change/supersession procedure contains incomplete steps.
A production registry/catalogue structure for governed reusable Inventor content is not yet defined in the migration corpus.
